business_info.name: TechFlow Electronics
business_info.description: TechFlow Electronics is a leading online retailer specializing in premium electronics, laptops, smartphones, and accessories. We pride ourselves on fast shipping, quality products, and exceptional customer service.

laptops.description: High-performance laptops for professionals and gamers

returns.condition: Item must be unused and in original packaging

warranty.exclusions: Water damage from misuse not covered

payment.installments: 0% APR financing available on orders over $500 (12 months)

cancellation.process: Cancel in your account or contact support

faqs.question: What are your shipping options?
faqs.answer: We offer Standard (5-7 days, FREE over $100), Express (2-3 days, $24.99), Overnight ($49.99), and International (10-21 days). Choose during checkout!

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
faqs.answer: You have 30 days to return unused items in original packaging. Initiate a return in your account, and we'll email a prepaid shipping label. Refunds process 5-7 days after we receive it.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranties?
faqs.answer: Yes! All products come with 1-2 year manufacturer warranty. We also offer extended warranties up to 5 years for additional coverage.

faqs.question: Can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You will receive a tracking number via email after shipment. You can also track it in your TechFlow account anytime.

faqs.question: Where is my order?
faqs.answer: You can track your order in real-time using the tracking number we emailed you after shipment. Log into your account or click the tracking link in your email.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Debit, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We also offer 0% APR financing on orders over $500.

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: 100% secure! We use 256-bit SSL encryption and are PCI-DSS compliant. Your data is never stored on our servers.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Visit our website and click Sign Up. Provide your email, password, and basic info. You will get instant access to order history and exclusive deals!

faqs.question: Do you have a loyalty program?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our TechFlow Rewards program gives you points on every purchase. Earn 1 point per dollar spent, redeemable for discounts!

faqs.question: What if a product arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Contact us immediately with photos. We will replace it or refund 100%. Damaged shipments are rare, but we guarantee satisfaction.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes! We ship to over 150 countries. International delivery takes 10-21 business days. Customers are responsible for customs duties and taxes.

faqs.question: How long does a refund take?
faqs.answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect your returned item. The refund appears on your original payment method.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel before shipment in your account or by contacting support. Cancellations after shipment follow our standard return policy.

faqs.question: What laptops do you sell?
faqs.answer: We carry ProBook 15X Ultra ($1,299), UltraBook Air M2 ($899), GameForce RTX 5080 ($1,899), WorkStation Pro 17 ($1,599), and SlimBook 14 ($649). Visit our laptops section for full specs.

faqs.question: What smartphones do you have?
faqs.answer: Our lineup includes TechFlow Pro Max ($999), TechFlow Lite ($449), and TechFlow Fold ($1,499). We also sell Tab Elite 12 and Tab Mini 8 tablets.

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes! Standard shipping is FREE on all orders over $100. Orders under $100 have a $9.99 standard shipping fee.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Call 1-800-TECHFLOW (1-800-832-4356), email support@techflowelectronics.com, or use live chat Mon-Sat 9AM-9PM EST.

faqs.question: What is your price match policy?
faqs.answer: Found a lower price within 7 days? Email us with proof from an authorized retailer. We price match and give an extra 10% off!

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page. We email a reset link valid for 24 hours. Check spam if you don't see it within 5 minutes.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes! 0% APR financing is available on orders over $500 for 12 months. Select financing at checkout to apply.

faqs.question: What accessories do you sell?
faqs.answer: We offer chargers, headphones, laptop sleeves, wireless mice, webcams, and mechanical keyboards. Browse our accessories section for full catalog.

faqs.question: How do I earn loyalty points?
faqs.answer: Sign up for TechFlow Rewards (free). Earn 1 point per dollar spent. Redeem 100 points for $5 off your next order.

faqs.question: What is your warranty coverage?
faqs.answer: Standard 1-2 year manufacturer warranty covers defects. Extended warranty up to 5 years adds accidental damage protection. Water damage from misuse is excluded.

faqs.question: Can I change my shipping address?
faqs.answer: Contact support immediately if your order hasn't shipped. Once shipped, address changes are not possible — you may need to refuse delivery and reorder.

faqs.question: Do you have a student discount?
faqs.answer: Yes! Students get 10% off with a valid .edu email. Sign up for our student program on the website to receive your discount code.

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: Our online store is open 24/7. Phone support is available Monday-Sunday 8AM-11PM EST. Live chat is Mon-Sat 9AM-9PM EST.

customer_support.escalation: Ask for a supervisor via phone or email for unresolved issues within 48 hours
customer_support.response_time: Email responses within 24 hours; live chat immediate during hours

common_issues.forgot_password: Click Forgot Password on login. We will email you a reset link (valid 24 hours). Create a new password and you are back in!
common_issues.slow_checkout: Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Del) and cookies. Disable ad-blockers temporarily. Or try a different browser.
common_issues.out_of_stock: Subscribe to our notification and we will email when it is back! Usually restocks within 2-4 weeks.
common_issues.price_match: Found a lower price? Email support@techflowelectronics.com within 7 days with proof. We will price match plus give 10% off!
common_issues.payment_declined: Verify card details, ensure sufficient funds, and try a different payment method. Contact your bank if the issue persists.
common_issues.order_not_received: Check tracking in your account. If marked delivered but not received, contact us within 48 hours for investigation.
common_issues.wrong_item_shipped: Contact support with your order number and photos. We will send the correct item and provide a prepaid return label.
common_issues.account_locked: Too many failed login attempts lock your account for 30 minutes. Use Forgot Password or wait and try again.
